extracted.intended_audience: research mathematicians in arithmetic geometry/number theory (readers familiar with Mochizuki's IUT series)
extracted.subtask_description: Reading and understanding advanced research-level definitions, propositions, and constructions in Shinichi Mochizuki's Inter-universal Teichmüller Theory (IUT) — specifically sections on prime-strips, tensor packets, integral structures, and related monoid/Frobenioid constructions.
